newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Vodni sees CZK 150-200mln '97 gross.
newsitem.headline: Czech Vodni sees CZK 150-200mln '97 gross.

text.p: The Czech construction group Vodni Stavby Praha a.s. expects 1997 gross profit of 150 to 200 million crowns after pre-tax profit of 151 million crowns last year, financial director Zeno Veselik said.
"We hoped that this year we would attain (gross) profit on the order of 200 million," Veselik told a news conference after the company's annual general meeting.
He added that the company did not expect to pay a lower dividend on 1997 profit than the 27 crowns which shareholders approved to be paid on 1996 profits.
